question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>X</mi><mo>=</mo><mfenced close="}" open="{" separators="|"><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>N</mi><mo>:</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>≤</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>≤</mo><mn>50</mn></mrow></mfenced></math>. If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mo>=</mo><mfenced open="{" close="}" separators="|"><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>X</mi><mo>:</mo><mo> </mo><mi>n </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mi>s </mi><mi>a </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">u</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><mi>e </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi><mo> </mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><mo>=</mo><mfenced open="{" close="}" separators="|"><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>X</mi><mo>:</mo><mo> </mo><mi>n </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mi>s </mi><mi>a </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">u</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><mi>e </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi><mi>f </mi><mn>7</mn></mrow></mfenced></math>, then the number of elements in the smallest subset of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>X</mi></math>, containing both <math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math> and <math><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></math>, is.

solution.text:
Here, A=2,4,6,....50 and B=7,14,...49

Required smallest subset is A∪B.

So, nA∪B=nA+nB-nA∩B
=25+7-3
=29.
